items.mainDefect: The cache is not checked again after the write lock is taken, so at a non-Dev cold start every caller waiting on the lock re-reads and re-parses assets-manifest.json.

secondary.defect: In Dev mode every call takes the process-wide exclusive write lock and holds it during disk I/O, so all concurrent index, frontend-settings and recovery callers run one at a time.
